sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ऋषयः सर्व एव ते ।ततो निवेदयामासुर्लवणो ववृधे यथा ।। ७.६२.२ ॥
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣayaḥ sarva eva te ।tato nivedayāmāsurlavaṇo vavṛdhe yathā ।। 7.62.2 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Rama's words, all those sages then reported how Lavana had grown in power.
